title: Connascence
summary: CONNASCENCE, noun [Latin , to be born.] 1. The common birth of two or more at the same time; production of two or more together. 2. A being born or produced with another. 3. The act of growing togethe

inlines.v: CONNASCENCE, noun [Latin , to be born.] 1. The common birth of two or more at the same time; production of two or more together. 2. A being born or produced with another. 3. The act of growing together, or at the same time.
